counter_evidence.text: Against a payment restart, crash or unreachability explanation: payment's pod name, container image and image digest are identical at every sampled point from 20:44:54Z to 21:44:54Z, and payment's failing spans complete in 563–723 microseconds with an application-level error message and stack trace rather than connection or availability errors.

fact.text: The alert expression evaluates to 0 at 21:40:00Z and 21:41:00Z, 0.412 at 21:42:00Z, 0.768 at 21:43:00Z and 1.0 at both 21:44:00Z and 21:45:00Z for checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder SERVER spans, i.e. essentially all PlaceOrder server spans in the last two sampled minutes ended in STATUS_CODE_ERROR.

Over the 10 minutes ending 21:45:00Z the only checkout error spans present are oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (SPAN_KIND_SERVER, increase 7.13145) and oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (SPAN_KIND_CLIENT, increase 7.13145); no other checkout operation has error spans in that window.

Payment service server spans for grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge carry STATUS_CODE_ERROR (status_tags error=true, otel.status_code=ERROR) with grpc.error_message and exception.message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' and stacktrace 'Error: Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold at module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13) at async Object.chargeServiceHandler [as charge] (/usr/src/app/index.js:21:22)', for service payment, service_version 2.0.2, in the read rows starting 21:42:26Z–21:44:46Z.

Checkout PlaceOrder server spans carry otel.status_description 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' with rpc.grpc.status_code 13, and the corresponding checkout client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge carries the same status description with rpc.grpc.status_code 2.

The same payment failure existed before the checkout pod replacement: traces sampled at 20:50:37Z and 20:51:45Z show payment grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge STATUS_CODE_ERROR with the identical message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' and the identical charge.js:37:13 stack location, with checkout PlaceOrder failing at rpc.grpc.status_code 13.

Payment Charge server-span error rate has two bursts within the hour: nonzero 10-minute error rates from 20:54:54Z (0.0167) down to 21:04:54Z (0.0037), zeros from 21:09:54Z through 21:39:54Z, then nonzero again at 21:40:54Z (0.00185), 21:42:54Z (0.00556) and 21:44:54Z (0.0111), while the STATUS_CODE_UNSET rate falls to 0 at 21:44:54Z.

Payment's pod did not change during the window: kube_pod_container_info shows the payment container in pod payment-6f7bc865d6-k4hpb with image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.0.2-payment and image_id sha256:33f327b357617379bfa3b292f430d1f06e66e2872494125a40bae14d8fe57d87 at every sampled point from 20:44:54Z to 21:44:54Z, and kube_deployment_created for deployment payment is constant (1794942592).

Checkout's pod was replaced during the window with the identical image digest: the checkout container appears in pod checkout-5bd784676b-g8khs at sampled points 20:44:54Z–21:29:54Z and in pod checkout-8674764b75-q2tgj at 21:34:54Z–21:44:54Z, both with image_id ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo@sha256:5ab0d7b9003206a32c72ef48b42a535c3f70565251d7d832f86fe9f249f16635 (image 2.0.2-checkout, differing container_id only), i.e. a pod replacement without an image-digest change, consistent with the operator note that deployment otel-demo/checkout was rolled out at 2026-11-17T21:31:22Z as rel-20261117213122.

Payment's successful-transaction counter stopped advancing when the failures returned: app_payment_transactions_total USD rose from 95 at 20:44:54Z to 147 at 21:40:54Z and then stayed at 147 through 21:44:54Z, while the CAD series stayed at 17 from 21:29:54Z onward.

On the same traces the failure propagated outward as HTTP 500: frontend spans for 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' and POST with http.status_code 500 and otel.status_code ERROR, frontend-proxy spans 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' with http.status_code 500, and load-generator POST spans with http.status_code 500.

A flagd feature flag keyed paymentFailure exists with reason STATIC and variants 'off' and '100%', and its impression/reason counters advanced inside the window (variant '100%' 2 to 22 by 20:59:54Z and 24 by 21:44:54Z; variant 'off' 37 to 39 early and 39 to 52 between 21:34:54Z and 21:39:54Z; reason counter 39 to 60 to 61 to 76); these counters do not expose the flag's current value or its per-request result.

A 15-minute error-span increase query over 21:30:00Z–21:45:04Z returned error series only for service_name ad, checkout, flagd, frontend, frontend-proxy, load-generator, payment and recommendation (ad, flagd and recommendation on flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream), and returned no error series for cart, currency, shipping, product-catalog, email or quote.

hypothesis.text: The failure terminates inside payment: payment's own charge handler (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37) throws the 'Invalid token' error within roughly 0.6 ms, no outgoing client span from payment accompanies these spans, and checkout's only failing dependency is oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, so payment is the deepest observed origin of the checkout PlaceOrder errors rather than a dependency of payment failing.

The rejections may be driven by the flagd feature flag paymentFailure (variants 'off'/'100%', reason STATIC) being enabled for these charges, which would make flag configuration rather than payment code the origin; this is unverified because the impression and reason counters do not show the flag's current value and no per-request flag result appears in the spans.

The checkout rollout of 2026-11-17T21:31:22Z (rel-20261117213122) could have changed what checkout sends to payment (card/token content) so that payment rejects it, moving the origin upstream of payment; this remains unverified and is weakened by the identical payment 'Invalid token' failure at 20:50:37Z–20:51:45Z before that pod replacement.

recommendation.text: Retrieve the flagd definition and per-request evaluation of the paymentFailure flag, since its current value is the main open question separating a payment-code fault from a fault-injection/flag-configuration fault.

Review the configuration diff of checkout release rel-20261117213122 (same image digest sha256:5ab0d7b9...) and compare the card/token fields of successful versus failing Charge requests, since the 'Invalid token' message is the exact diagnostic but the token's origin is not visible in the telemetry.

gaps: Change history is not integrated (not_integrated includes change_history), so the content of checkout release rel-20261117213122 and of any flagd configuration change could not be read; the operator note was corroborated only as a pod replacement with unchanged checkout image digest.
Pod logs are not integrated (not_integrated includes pod_logs), so payment-side log lines around the 'Invalid token' rejection (for example which card or token value was rejected) could not be read.

The value the flagd flag paymentFailure returned per request is not observable: feature_flag_flagd_impression_total and feature_flag_flagd_result_reason_total expose only cumulative counts with reason STATIC, so flag-driven fault injection remains unconfirmed.

The origin of the rejected token (content produced by frontend/checkout versus payment-side validation) is unknown; no span attributes, logs or change records showing request card fields were available.

The payment trace listing query over 21:42:00Z–21:45:04Z returned RESULT_TOO_LARGE (status error, not citable) and only a 25-row read slice was adopted, and that slice view is marked truncated true, so the payment error evidence covers the rows shown, not every payment span in that window.

report.summary: The alert reproduces: the checkout PlaceOrder server-span error ratio is 0 at 21:40:00Z–21:41:00Z, 0.412 at 21:42:00Z, 0.768 at 21:43:00Z and 1.0 at 21:44:00Z and 21:45:00Z. Over the 10 minutes to 21:45:00Z the only checkout error spans are oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (SPAN_KIND_SERVER) and the checkout CLIENT span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, with equal increases. The failing leaf is payment's own charge handler: its server span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge carries 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' thrown from module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13) in service payment, service_version 2.0.2, and checkout PlaceOrder fails with otel.status_description 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' and rpc.grpc.status_code 13. The frontend, frontend-proxy and load-generator HTTP 500 spans are the same traces propagating the failure. Payment's pod (payment-6f7bc865d6-k4hpb, image digest sha256:33f327b3...) is unchanged through the hour; checkout was replaced around 21:31Z by a config-only redeploy (checkout-5bd784676b-g8khs to checkout-8674764b75-q2tgj, identical image digest sha256:5ab0d7b9...). The identical payment 'Invalid token' failure is also visible at 20:50:37Z–20:51:45Z on the previous checkout pod, so that redeploy is not required for the failure. Whether the rejection is driven by the flagd flag paymentFailure (variants 'off' and '100%' exist) or by the token content the caller sends remains unknown, so the origin inside payment is a supported cause while the trigger is not resolved.
